input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.5 (Effect of Termination) addresses only accrued payment obligations; there is no transition-assistance, data-export/return, or deletion mechanic anywhere in the Agreement. Section 11.6 (Content) only allocates responsibility for Content, Section 14.18 (Data Protection) only covers processing instructions, and Section 14.2 (Survival) adds no exit obligations. For a hosted services agreement this absence fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days), so we insert a new Section 3.6 at the preferred position: six months' assistance at then-current rates, return of Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after return. We use the Agreement's defined term "Content" (information, software and data Customer provides) rather than introducing an undefined "Customer Data".

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Content return/deletion obligations into § 3.5 Effect of Termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanics, so we have added a short transition and data-return paragraph in Section 3.5: up to six months of assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days if needed.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Return of Content. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return all Content to Customer in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete all Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
